title: Early Modes of Navigation
authors: Augustus Henry Lane Fox Pitt Rivers
version: Journal of the Anthropological Institute vol. 4 (1875), transcribed by Pitt Rivers Museum
lineage: The museum transcription was inspected. The 1875 paper supplies no specific early references. This is a source-identified paraphrase; its attribution is separate from Settle’s direct words.

passages.note: Frobisher Straits paragraph: 1577 report of two skin-frame boat types; the author interprets the small type as covered except at the occupant’s place.
